scientific_integrity: The proof separates source-supplied generic-mix and meet-closure facts from the derived orbit enumeration. The Greg-tree refinement is anchored to OEIS A048160 and independently recomputed from its species equation before the graph weights are applied.
scientific_limitations: The rooted Greg-tree refinement is classical and is not claimed as new. Novelty is limited to the explicit graph-weighted identification with injective ordered-tuple orbits of the Rado meet-tree and its consequences; an unindexed prior observation remains possible.
title: Graph-weighted Greg-tree orbit profile of the Rado meet-tree
